integrity: Analytic proof of the full unconditional and mixed-edge conditional laws; independent audit has not been performed. Exact formulas checked with symbolic definite integration and separate quadrature and sampling.
scientific_limitations: Only the unit-similarity class of equilateral triangles under independent uniform full-perimeter arclength sampling. Known one-point-per-side evaluation is credited rather than claimed original; the first complete question formulation found already contains unevaluated triple integrals. Unindexed earlier closed evaluations remain a risk.
title: Exact acute-triangle probability for independent uniform perimeter points of an equilateral triangle
